introHtml: Insulated bowls, plates, and trays keep food at the right temperature during outdoor events, employee lunches, or client catering. Unlike standard servingware, these pieces feature double-wall construction or thermal liners that maintain heat or cold for hours. Perfect for branded corporate picnics, trade show hospitality suites, or safety crew meals on remote job sites. Choose from melamine or plastic construction with your logo imprinted for lasting visibility.
